allows_multi_destination.description: Permits multiple destinations per method type.

discloses_location_availability.description: Whether the business discloses destination-level availability in catalog responses. Defaults to false: businesses opt in to disclosure. When false, businesses MUST NOT return per-destination availability and MAY still return availability_summary without destinations. Platforms MUST NOT infer availability from the presence or absence of destinations in catalog responses.

discloses_origin.description: Whether the business may disclose fulfillment origins. When false, origin and transfer_origin SHOULD be omitted.
